2122411464694604166.en_summary: $NVDA - JENSEN HUANG TRANSFERRED OVER $10 BILLION IN NVIDIA STOCK TO FAMILY TRUST BEFORE DOWNFALL Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and his wife transferred nearly 60 million shares, worth over $10.5 billion, into an irrevocable family trust in March, according to SEC filings reviewed by Barron's. The transfer followed a 10-year estate-planning strategy using trusts initially funded with approximately $51 million in Nvidia shares in 2016. Estate attorneys say the structure could allow the accumulated gains to pass to heirs without federal estate tax. The transfer preceded Huang's resignation and Nvidia's recent stock selloff.
2122411464694604166.zh_summary: $NVDA - JENSEN HUANG在下台前將超過100億美元的NVIDIA股票轉移到家族信託中 前Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang和他的妻子根據Barron's審查的SEC文件，在3月將近6000萬股、價值超過105億美元的股票轉移到不可撤銷的家族信託中。該轉移遵循10年遺產規劃策略，使用2016年最初以約5100萬美元Nvidia股票資助的信託。遺產律師表示該結構可能允許累積收益傳給繼承人而無需聯邦遺產稅。該轉移先於Huang的辭職和Nvidia最近的股票拋售。
